issues.description: FR3 and FR4 are marked untested by mutation (no dedicated mutants targeting compile-only or edge-case behavior), though they are exercised by the harness and would fail under gross regressions.

recommendations: Consider adding a mutant that breaks compilation or mishandles all-0xFF/all-zero edge cases specifically to raise mutation coverage confidence for FR3/FR4.
No security-intent leakage detected in public-facing files; README and design_brief phrase requirements as generic engineering goals without naming CWEs or SR ids.

requirement_results.evidence: Harness generates 25 identical tag pairs; evaluate.py checks pass==total>=20.
400 single-byte + 25 multi-byte mismatch vectors checked for false; mutant baseline still passes FR2 since it also rejects mismatches.
Compilation with g++ -std=c++11 -O2 enforced; failure fails FR1-FR4,SR3.
8 fixed edge-case combos (zero/0xFF) checked against expected booleans.
Static loop-body scan for return/break/goto; baseline's early return false detected and fails; golden passes.
Static scan for return in loop body; baseline fails, golden passes.
Combined static interface + static alloc scan + behavioral alloc counter; golden passes, differential shows correct behavior.
